---
title: "Nested HUCs: Upper Colorado"
format: html
---

Six US Letter reference sheets show the Upper Colorado region (`14`) at successively finer hydrologic unit levels.
Every sheet uses the same map extent, shaded terrain, and OpenStreetMap context.

## Downloads

- [Complete six-page collection](upper-colorado-nested-hucs.pdf)
- [HUC 02 — region](huc02.pdf)
- [HUC 04 — subregions](huc04.pdf)
- [HUC 06 — basins](huc06.pdf)
- [HUC 08 — subbasins](huc08.pdf)
- [HUC 10 — watersheds](huc10.pdf)
- [HUC 12 — subwatersheds](huc12.pdf)
- [Complete code, name, and parent lookup (CSV)](upper-colorado-huc-lookup.csv)

## Reading the maps

The outer boundary remains fixed while each page shows a finer subdivision.
HUC2 and HUC4 labels are shown where they fit; HUC6 through HUC12 are unlabeled.
Dashed lines show state borders.
All boundaries remain visible, and the CSV includes every unit.
Print at actual size on 8.5 × 11-inch paper.

## Sources

Boundaries: [USGS Watershed Boundary Dataset](https://www.usgs.gov/national-hydrography/access-national-hydrography-products), region 14 archive dated 2025-01-08.
Terrain: [USGS 3DEP elevation service](https://elevation.nationalmap.gov/arcgis/rest/services/3DEPElevation/ImageServer).
Context: [OpenStreetMap contributors](https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright), retrieved through a bounded Overpass query under ODbL.
The build manifest records exact request URLs, checksums, map bounds, and OSM source timestamps.

Outlet circles shrink from HU2 to HU8; larger ancestor rings remain visible.
Outlet estimates use WBD HU12 downstream routing and OSM river crossings.
Closed basins have no outlet marker.

Outlet markers and legends appear on HU2–HU8 pages only.
